Hip Replacement Surgery in Ahmedabad

At Silver Touch Hospitals, we offer state-of-the-art solutions for joint pain and loss of mobility through specialised orthopedic treatment. If walking, bending, or even lying in bed has become painful due to chronic hip pain, it might be time to seek a hip replacement in Ahmedabad.
Hip replacement surgery entails replacing the worn-out and damaged parts of the hip joint with man-made implants. It can greatly enhance your mobility, minimise pain, and allow for independence. Regardless of the reason — osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, avascular necrosis, or post-traumatic injury — our staff is dedicated to accompanying you through the process, from diagnosis to healing.

What is Hip Replacement?

Hip replacement is a surgical procedure in which a damaged or worn-out hip joint is replaced with an artificial implant. It helps reduce pain, improve mobility, and enhance the overall quality of life.

When Is Hip Replacement Indicated?

We generally suggest hip replacement for patients who:

  • Have persistent hip or groin pain that interferes with activities of daily life
  • Have trouble walking or climbing stairs
  • Experience stiffness that restricts joint movement
  • Find that painkillers, injections, and physiotherapy relieve nothing
  • Have extensive joint damage on X-ray or MRI

We do both total and partial (hemi) hip replacements, as determined by the status of your joint. With contemporary implants and minimally invasive surgical methods, our aim is to enable patients to heal more quickly and get back to their daily routines with more ease.

Types of Hip Replacement Surgery

  • Total Hip Replacement
  • Partial Hip Replacement
  • Revision Hip Replacement

Why Choose Silver Touch Hospitals for Hip Replacement in Ahmedabad?

Silver Touch Hospitals stands out with a reputation for dependable and skilled hip replacement in Ahmedabad since we blend surgical expertise with post-op care customised to the individual. This is what we provide:

  • Senior orthopedic and joint replacement specialists
  • Pre-surgery planning using state-of-the-art imaging
  • Modular OTs and high-sterility zones
  • Individualised rehabilitation protocols with in-house physiotherapists
  • 24×7 monitoring and post-op pain relief

Recovery and Rehabilitation After Hip Replacement

Following surgery, most patients can walk with support within 24–48 hours. Recovery is complete within a few weeks with supervised physiotherapy. Our post-discharge care isn’t over yet — we monitor regular follow-ups to maintain safe recovery and restore normal function.

Benefits of Hip Replacement Surgery

  • Pain relief
  • Improved mobility
  • Better quality of life
  • Long-term joint function

Ready to Live a Pain-free Life?

Take control of your life. Schedule a consultation at Silver Touch Hospitals and begin the journey towards a pain-free life. You can talk to our hip replacement specialists at any of our hospitals across Ahmedabad.
